data.title: 佩丽卡 · 雪原观测站读数
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 雪原观测站读数】清晨的雪原观测站外，佩丽卡穿着厚实的白蓝拼色防寒派克服，保暖长裤和手套挡住冷风。她站在固定的传感器旁，一手稳住读数板，另一手按下确认键，回头示意记录完成——「读数已经稳定。我们进站核对下一组数据。」
data.action: 站在传感器旁，一手托读数板，另一手按下确认键
data.promptProse: Perlica stands between the fixed sensor housing and the observation-station entrance, steadying a reading tablet with one gloved hand and pressing its confirmation key with the other. She looks back to signal that the reading is complete. Keep the white-and-gray-blue insulated parka, trousers and gloves in the medium shot. The sensor occupies the nearer edge; the doorway opens behind her onto a short, darker entry passage, while the snowfield remains visible beyond the station wall. Cold morning light grazes the hood and snow ridges. The entrance lamp casts a warmer patch across the tablet-side glove and the door jamb, with the sensor base anchored by a soft blue-gray shadow.
data.camera: medium shot, sensor housing and tablet visible beside the station entrance
data.lighting: 雪原清晨冷光与入口暖灯
